pages.text:
Jeff has no hump on top. His pals
are grand and stroll the land.
His pals have a hump on top.

Can the ant clan help and lump
some sand on top?

The ants clump sand on top of
Jeff. Jeff grins. A hump on top!

The sand slips off. Jeff is in a
huff and has a drink.

Jeff sits in a slump. Jeff still
has no hump on top.
Liz has no hump. Can Liz help?

Come and rest, Jeff. Trust me,
it is best not to huff and slump.

Liz and Jeff are glad not to
have a hump on top. Liz has a
big grin.
